in_scope: Canonical active and template remote config artifacts (.cursor/remote.json parity)
Schema/contract guidance and deterministic validation rules
Mode-aware behavior: fail-fast only when REMOTE_EXECUTION=1
Actionable remote config error message contract
Security constraints for secrets handling in remote config
README and runbook updates for setup and validation expectations
Positive and negative QA coverage planning for remote config failure modes

risks: Active/template drift for remote contract artifacts and docs
Validation rules accidentally running in REMOTE_EXECUTION=0 mode
Insufficiently actionable errors causing slow remediation
Secret-like values being copied into committed config examples
Negative-path coverage missing one or more fail-fast scenarios
